summary: Phase 2 SWOT Save-as-Template HIGH bug RE-TEST PASSED end-to-end after the _normalize_life_area_id() fix in /app/backend/routes/swot.py. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (8 from existing test_swot_save_as_template.py + 7 new in test_swot_life_area_normalization.py covering all 3 input shapes — bare slug 'career', canonical 'la_career', label 'Career' — plus an unknown→'' wildcard regression guard and a full round-trip through /api/hos/templates/suggest). Frontend: completed the intake wizard at /tools/new-decision?module=swot through Acting As → Career → Problem → Define → Find Templates and confirmed the picker now lists 9 SWOT-sourced templates, each card showing color-coded S(green)/W(red)/O(blue)/T(orange) flag chips with counts. Both bug fix verifications confirmed. Note: expo-av deprecation warning is still surfacing in console — should migrate to expo-audio/expo-video (independent of this iteration).

minor.issue: Endpoint either missing or not honoring DELETE — returned non-2xx for 8 cleanup calls. Test data (TEST_NORM_*, TEST_SUGGEST_*) remains in DB but is harmless. Worth confirming admin-only delete route exists.

issues: Scenario chips row is populated with full template names (e.g. 'TEST_UI_CS_1780053644') instead of curated scenario titles. Likely the /hos/scenarios endpoint is returning template-derived rows. Cosmetic — does not block the template picker, but pollutes step 4 with raw IDs.

Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Multiple components use shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.
Console warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode'.

action_items: (Optional / out-of-scope) Migrate expo-av to expo-audio + expo-video before SDK 54.
(Optional) Replace shadow*/pointerEvents/Image.resizeMode legacy style props with boxShadow + style.pointerEvents + props.resizeMode.

(Optional) Add a DELETE /api/hos/templates/{id} admin endpoint to let tests clean up after themselves; current run leaves 9 TEST_* templates in the la_career/swot bucket.

frontend/app/tools/new-decision.tsx renders the SWOT chip via SWOT_FLAG_META, which now produces accessible color-coded chips on each factor (verified at runtime).

rca_of_issue: Previous iteration HIGH bug RCA: SWOT.save-as-template was storing life_area_id as the raw 'life_area' string from the SWOT record (often the human label 'Career'), but /api/hos/templates/suggest filters by canonical id 'la_career'. Fix in /app/backend/routes/swot.py: _normalize_life_area_id() now resolves the input against data/hos_seed_data.LIFE_AREAS using id→id, slug→id, and case-insensitive name→id, returning '' for unknown values (so unknowns become wildcard rather than mismatched). Verified by parametrized tests for all three input shapes and a positive suggest-endpoint round-trip.
